scope: Local backend search/pagination audit; instruction publication only; backend audit fixes are uncommitted and not deployed
additionalReview: Raw seasonal SQL filter/count/pagination plus server-side ILIKE and post-fetch sorting/shared-include use

findings.issue: Community top/hot ranking happened after LIMIT/OFFSET over newest posts
findings.fix: Select rank expression and order globally in PostgreSQL before pagination; selected alias is valid in inner/outer query; safe age floor handles future timestamps

findings.issue: Community tag filter removed nonmatching tags from matched posts
findings.fix: Correlated EXISTS selects matching posts while the original tag include hydrates every public tag; distinct counts and role visibility retained

findings.issue: Nonunique page order allowed tied content timestamps/unit price keys to reorder or repeat rows across pages
findings.fix: Unique ID tie-breakers for community, published/admin content, source drafts, current prices and history

validation.database: Fresh runner-owned local PostgreSQL 14, real migrations through 42, synthetic fixtures; containers and volumes removed

executionDiagnostics: Initial ordering fixture omitted the required Market.tags array; corrected before the valid red baseline

First green implementation run passed all new PostgreSQL cases; one legacy mocked-query expectation still asserted the old two-key price order; updated to the ID tie-breaker and reran the complete suite
exemptions: Remain disabled; no production environment, service, credential, exemption or fixture changed
limits: Database regressions use synthetic local data, not restored production or live requests
Unique ordering applies to a fixed eligible dataset; offset pagination does not supply a snapshot across concurrent edits/votes
Backend publication, PR and deployment are outside this audit instruction publication and still require an authorized release
